audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Urgot all 7 stages while Illaoi wins 52.97% over 925 games, and every prose block declared the lane lost.
audit.why: Illaoi's Test of Spirit is 900 range against Urgot's 475 Disdain and 490 Purge; once her full kit is online at 3 she dictates the range, which matches the favourable win rate.
audit.corrected: Urgot keeps Levels 1-2 (Corrosive Charge 800 range plus Echoing Flames). Level 3 is skill; Levels 4-5, 6, first item and 2+ items go to Illaoi.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were written entirely as Urgot spikes; Illaoi's own spikes were absent.
audit.why: Illaoi's spikes are level 3 (full kit), level 6 (Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit, 120/95/70s), and Iceborn Gauntlet. Urgot's real spikes are Purge rank-up (12/9/6/3/0s cooldown) and R at 6 (100/85/70s, 2500 range).
audit.corrected: spikes[0] rewritten around Purge's 490 range and self-slow; spikes[1] around Fear Beyond Death's 100s rank-1 cooldown and the execute threshold; spikes[2] Iceborn Gauntlet; spikes[3] the two-item side lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Urgot's Disdain (E) is a charge, and using it to escape after Test of Spirit lands breaks the spirit tether.
audit.why: Riot's text for Illaoi E: 'if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel.' Disdain is Urgot's only movement tool (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s), so his escape is what makes him a Vessel.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon, mid, whys[3] and spikes[3]. Also corrected the range picture: E 900 vs Disdain 475 and Purge 490, and Purge slows Urgot himself while it channels, which holds him inside tentacle swings.

audit.why: Disdain at 14-16s is the punishable cooldown and the existing text already tracks it; added the real number where it makes advice concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kit-file derived flags list 'grounding' on Illaoi's R (Leap of Faith).
audit.why: Riot's own description of Leap of Faith mentions only damage and tentacle spawning — no grounding. Per the brief's rule, the description wins.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim written anywhere in this matchup.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Land Test of Spirit' in wants.you[0] as a probable wrong name. Test of Spirit is the correct Riot name for Illaoi's E — false positive.

edits.after: At L3 your E outranges his 475 Disdain; his Purge must close.

edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit; his R is 100s at rank 1.

edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet lands your tentacles; Purge makes him stand still.

edits.before: Urgot's Purge (W) shreds you while he strafes, and Corrosive Charge (Q) plus Disdain (E) let him poke and reposition out of your Test of Spirit (E) tether range. His passive shotgun legs auto-fire on slowed or low targets, so extended trades favour him hard; you can never afford to stand and W-Q into him.
edits.after: Urgot's Purge (W) shreds while he strafes, but it slows him and only reaches 490 — your Test of Spirit (E) is 900. Pull his spirit at max range, then Harsh Lesson (W, 4s) onto the spirit so every tentacle swings; the echoed damage lands on him while he is stuck grinding the wave he cannot leave.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death (R) executes you below the threshold and drags you back in — a straight counter to your R (Leap of Faith) all-in, since he can R you mid-tentacle-spawn and reset the fight. Never dive him at low HP; his execute line is longer than your comfort zone.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death (R) is a 2500-range execute on a 100s cooldown at rank 1 — stay above the threshold and it is a wasted ultimate. Your Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle for every champion hit, so commit it inside your field rather than open ground, and ideally once his R is spent.

edits.before: With a first item (often Black Cleaver) Urgot's Purge uptime and tankiness let him win any prolonged fight and shove you in. Farm carefully and use tentacles only to zone, not to commit.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet is your first-item spike: the slow keeps him inside the tentacle swings, and Purge already roots him in place while it channels. Force the fight the moment it completes, with Disdain on cooldown.

edits.before: Urgot scales into an unkillable frontline that shreds and executes; your tentacle field helps in teamfights but he walks through it with Purge active. Play flanks and avoid his R execute range.
edits.after: Side lane with two items is your window: his only movement tool is Disdain on a 14s cooldown, and charging out after your E breaks the spirit tether and turns him into a Vessel. Stay clear of his 2500-range R line.

edits.before: Urgot owns L1-2: Corrosive Charge (Q) pokes for free and his shotgun-leg passive punishes any step-up, so your E-tether attempts get walked out of. Farm at range and don't trade into his Q.
edits.after: Urgot owns L1-2: Corrosive Charge (Q) reaches 800 and Echoing Flames punishes any step-up. It costs a flat 70 mana though — farm at range, let him burn it, and take your first Test of Spirit once he is dry.

edits.before: L3-6 all belong to Urgot. Purge (W) out-DPSes your W-Q rotation, Disdain (E) flips you out of tentacle range, and once his R (Fear Beyond Death) is up your Leap of Faith all-in gets countered by his execute. There is no clean kill window for you here.
edits.after: L3-6 swings to you. Test of Spirit (E) is 900 range against his 475 Disdain, and if he charges out after you land it the tether breaks and he becomes a Vessel. Purge slows him while it channels, so W the spirit and let the echoed damage do the work.

edits.before: With Black Cleaver and tank items Urgot shreds and executes through your kit; his frontline walks your tentacle field with Purge running. Rely on sidelane CS and teamfight flanks, and never enter his execute range.
edits.after: Urgot is still a real shred frontline, so pick your ground: fight beside terrain where tentacles can spawn, hold Leap of Faith for his commit, and never walk into the Fear Beyond Death line while you sit below the execute threshold.

edits.before: Land Test of Spirit (E) when Urgot's Purge (W) is down
edits.after: Land Test of Spirit (E) from 900, outside his 475 Disdain

edits.before: His W out-trades and his range pokes you — dodge his flip, fight when W is down.
edits.after: Purge slows him and reaches only 490 — E him from 900, W the spirit, punish Disdain.

edits.before: Dodge E and fight on his W cooldown. Track Disdain before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Land Test of Spirit from 900, then W the spirit. If he Disdains away, the tether breaks and he vessels.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Disdain and how disciplined your pattern is.

notes: Illaoi kit file flags 'grounding' on R (Leap of Faith); Riot's description says only damage plus a tentacle per champion hit. Treated the flag as a tooltip-parse misfire and made no grounding claim. suspectNames flagged 'Test of Spirit' as a wrong name — it is the correct Riot name, false positive. Level chart was 7/7 Urgot against a 52.97% Illaoi win rate over 925 games; rows repaired in matched full/content pairs.
